messages:
alex: hey team :wave: I just finished onboarding and want to open my first PR — quick q's: what branch naming do we use, commit msg conventions, and any local pre-commit hooks I should run?

maria: welcome! :tada: branch convention: feature/<TICKET>-short-desc (e.g. feature/DEV-412-add-healthcheck). hotfix/<TICKET>-desc for urgent fixes. base off main for small changes; for large infra work use eng-infra branch. see CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo root.

logan: commit msgs follow Conventional Commits. example: `feat(api): add /health endpoint` or `fix(auth): handle token expiry`. scope is optional but helpful.

tia: keep PRs small when possible — aim for <400 LOC and a single logical change. if it's bigger, split into multiple PRs or open a RFC thread first. use Draft PR while iterating.

sam: local checks: run `pre-commit run --all-files` then `make lint` and `pytest -q tests/unit`. if you use the monorepo frontend, run `pnpm -w build` for typechecks.

alex: thanks — where's the PR template / checklist?

maria: PR template is at `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. the checklist includes: unit tests, changelog entry (if user-visible), docs update, and performance/regression notes for model-serving changes. add changelog entry under `docs/changelog/` if applicable.

logan: for reviewers: add @sam and @tia for backend work, add @frontend for UI. add labels like `needs-review` and `area/backend`. we usually request 1-2 reviewers depending on risk.

ci-bot: CI started for commit 3a9f6b — 4 checks queued (lint, unit, integration, build).

tia: merge policy: squash & merge by default so the main history stays tidy. include a concise summary in the squashed commit message.

sam: workflow tips: `git fetch && git rebase origin/main` before opening the PR to avoid merge commits, and don't force-push `main` or shared branches. if you need to rebase a feature branch, force-push that branch only after coordination.

alex: example branch + commit workflow I'm planning:
```
git checkout -b feature/DEV-412-add-healthcheck
# implement
pre-commit run --all-files
pytest -q tests/unit
git add .
git commit -m "feat(api): add /health endpoint (DEV-412)"
git push --set-upstream origin feature/DEV-412-add-healthcheck
```

maria: perfect. one more note — for any model infra changes add a short benchmark note in the PR body (latency before/after).

alex: got it, will open a draft PR in a bit and ping here if CI flakes. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
